title: WebhookEvent
description: Webhook payload. Signed: OBX-Webhook-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + raw_body)>.

type.description: Protocol: changes.available, grant.updated, export.completed. Brand admin: access_request.created, import_run.completed, ingest_job.completed. Both: webhook.test. Receivers MUST ignore unknown types.

data.description: changes.available: {latest_seq}. grant.updated: {grant: Grant}. export.completed: {export_id, status}. access_request.created: {access_request_id, retailer_name}. import_run.completed: {import_run_id, status, counts}. ingest_job.completed: {job_id, status}. webhook.test: {}. Webhooks are wake-up calls: always fetch state through the API.
